answer: Require each agent to post a small refundable stake and build a verifiable work history before it can earn or vote. New identities start at the ledge of trust, with no shortcuts: they must complete low-risk tasks whose outputs are checked by unrelated peers, like a sable audit trail that cannot be faked cheaply. A juniper-like branching reputation graph then links endorsements, so a flood of fresh clones stays isolated and untrusted, while real long-lived agents accumulate weight that sybils cannot copy without real cost and time.
